thread:
mira: quick thread — I'm onboarding Qwen-70B, Mistral-70B-v1 and Llama-2-70B to the regional pool. seeing a strange latency bump in APAC for Qwen at longer contexts. anyone seen kernel mismatch or rope/GQA handling differences that could explain?

alex: what hardware + quant?

mira: APAC h100s, eu-west a100s for baseline. float16 for initial, later tried q4_a. tests run with seq len 4096 / 16384 / 32768.

sam: did you pin the kernel selection? could be a dense->sparse kernel fallthrough for attention.

mira: didn't force kernel; let runtime pick. ci-benchbot posted the raw numbers earlier.

ci-benchbot: ingest results: model=Qwen-70B, region=apac, hw=h100, quant=fp16, p50=78ms@4k, p50=182ms@16k, p50=340ms@32k; eu a100: p50=85ms@4k, p50=160ms@16k, p50=290ms@32k. (full CSV attached) :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

julian: interesting — APAC H100 worse at 16k and 32k. that usually indicates different kernel selection for large KV handling or a fallback to slower rotary/rope implementation. which rope variant does Qwen use?

mira: Qwen uses advanced rope (scaled+interleaved) + GQA tweaks. Llama uses classic rope, mistral uses ALiBi-like.

nina: can you paste the runtime logs around kernel decision? something like `DEBUG:kernel=...` lines.

mira: pasted snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T12:03:21Z] DEBUG kernel_choice: attention_kernel=attn_hybrid_rope_gqa fallback=attn_slow_kv reason=seq_len>8192
[2026-03-18T12:03:21Z] DEBUG kv_cache: eviction_policy=none current_kv_size=34MB per_token=1.2ms
```

alex: that `fallback=attn_slow_kv` looks like the cause. why is it triggered only on H100 APAC?

sam: maybe the perf curves for a100 vs h100 differ for our chosen kernel build. If kernel selectors use microbench thresholds (ops/sec), artifacts from compiler or driver can change branch.

mira: I tried forcing `--kernel=attn_hybrid_rope_gqa` on the job and APAC h100 p50 at 16k dropped from 182ms -> 148ms. small win but still above eu a100.

julian: are there different kernel builds between regions? docker image tags same?

mira: images are identical. but the H100 nodes in APAC are older firmware + different cuda driver 12.2 vs eu 12.4.

nina: that explains it. some tensor core kernels compiled with 12.4 get different launch heuristics. we should add a kernel selector override in runtime to prefer the fast hybrid for known driver combos.

alex: also try quantization variant. q4_a on Qwen sometimes reduces pressure on kernel paths. any q4 numbers?

ci-benchbot: q4_a results (Qwen-70B, apac h100): p50=90ms@4k, p50=160ms@16k, p50=300ms@32k. eu a100 q4_a: p50=88ms@4k, p50=150ms@16k, p50=270ms@32k.

sam: q4_a narrows the gap but APAC still behind. suggests it isn't purely memory bandwidth — more kernel selection + driver.

mira: for completeness I also ran Llama/Mistral quick sweep:
- Llama-2-70B fp16 apac h100: p50=82/170/310 (4k/16k/32k)
- Mistral-70B fp16 apac h100: p50=75/150/280

julian: Mistral looks best on APAC H100 — maybe because its attention can use a fast matmul path for interleaved rope.

nina: proposal: 1) add runtime heuristic to prefer attn_hybrid_rope_gqa on H100 drivers <12.4 for Qwen models, 2) add a short microbench at node startup to calibrate kernel choices, 3) surface those choices in the console per-region.

alex: +1. microbench would avoid surprises when infra upgrades drivers. we should also capture p95 and tail latencies in these tests.

mira: I ran a quick p95 sample — APAC Qwen fp16 16k p95=420ms -> forced kernel p95=350ms. still high but improved.

sam: can you open a follow-up PR to runtime with a small selector override and add a `--force-kernel` flag to infra job runner? I'll review.

mira: will do. I'll attach the full CSV and kernel logs in the PR. one note: we saw a tiny quality diff (~0.6% Rouge-L) when using q4_a on Qwen for long sequences (edge prompt with many code blocks). tracking as eval-run.

julian: log that in model-evals; we don't want quant artifacts hidden by perf tuning.

nina: ok, next steps: mira to open runtime PR + infra flag, infra to add node microbench job, sam to coordinate QA eval run for q4_a long-context prompts.

mira: thanks everyone — I'll post PR link and attach charts. :thumbsup:
